note: Output captured 2026-11-03 from this repo's own runs, each exiting 0 (only exit-0 runs reach a PostToolUse hook). The username in file paths (pytest header, pnpm store line) was replaced with 'user'. 'needed' lists the strings Claude needs from a green run (counts and the pass line); scripts/eval-output-filter.py checks each exists in the raw fixture and reports any the trimmed output lost. 'stream' says which stream the runner wrote to. The two test-gates-chain files are several of the runs above executed one after another in one script, as a single chained command would print them; each is long enough to be trimmed.

test-gates-chain.txt.command: python -m unittest discover -s tools/claude-rate/tests -v && node --test tools/mcp-cost-server/test/ && npm --prefix site run test -- --reporter=verbose && python -m pytest -v tools/claude-rate/tests

test-gates-chain-b.txt.command: python -m unittest discover -s tools/claude-rate/tests -v && node --test tools/mcp-cost-server/test/ && python -m pytest -v tools/claude-rate/tests --durations=0 && python -m pytest -v tools/claude-rate/tests && python -m unittest discover -s tools/claude-rate/tests -v
